```{python}

level = 3
ratio_threshold = 1.3
minimum_false_count = 50 

df_eval_cp = df_eval.copy()
df_eval_cp["apet_manual_short"] = df_eval_cp['apet_manual'].str[:level]
df_eval_false_mapping = df_eval_cp[df_eval_cp['mapping_ok'] == False]

res = pd.DataFrame({
    'false_count': df_eval_false_mapping['apet_manual_short'].value_counts(),
    'global_count': df_eval_cp['apet_manual_short'].value_counts(),
    'false_prop': 100*df_eval_false_mapping['apet_manual_short'].value_counts(normalize=True),
    'global_prop': 100*df_eval_cp['apet_manual_short'].value_counts(normalize=True)
}).fillna(0)

res['ratio'] = res['false_prop'] / res['global_prop']

res = res[(res['ratio'] >= ratio_threshold) & (res['false_count'] >= minimum_false_count)]
res=res.sort_values('ratio', ascending=False)

res

```
